metadata.title: Palantir Stock Could Snap 7-Day Losing Streak, Cathie Wood’s ARK Bought the Dip<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Stock Could Snap 7-Day Losing Streak, Cathie Wood’s ARK Bought the Dip
Palantir Technologies stock looked set to break a seven-day losing streak on Friday, a day after the shares closed at a 12-month low.
